package.name: lane_detector
package.description: ROS 2 Jazzy lane-following package for TurtleBot3 Burger on a custom Gazebo Harmonic track with ramp, sharp turns, and beam occlusion. Uses OpenCV bird's-eye-view lane detection (yellow/white ROBOTIS AutoRace-style) with a PD controller and a position-triggered blind maneuver for camera-occluded sections.
